decisions.reason: The Sign In page already uses the referenced background; reusing it for the Provisioning Wizard does not change the Sign In page's styling requirement.
The source changes the Provisioning Wizard background and styling status but does not alter the footer or its optional use on informational pages.
The existing shared treatment already records a landing-page-derived background for informational pages; the Wizard's reuse of the Sign In background introduces no necessary change.
The same message separately addresses panel arrangement, but the Provisioning Wizard styling decision does not change the console navigation requirement.
A need to revisit Wizard styling does not establish any new or changed website design-token value.
Provisioning Wizard page styling is distinct from the Console shell styling guidelines and does not change the shell's current state.
Reusing a background derived from the landing-page treatment does not modify the landing page's own visual design.
The source does not change the website implementation stack, handoff package, or handoff objective.
The source contains no decision about website header navigation.
The source changes neither responsive-layout behavior nor breakpoint guidance.
